name: Tromokratis
oracle_text:
Tromokratis has hexproof unless it's attacking or blocking.
Tromokratis can't be blocked unless all creatures defending player controls block it. (If any creature that player controls doesn't block this creature, it can't be blocked.)
blocked_sentences: Tromokratis can't be blocked unless all creatures defending player controls block it. (If any creature that player controls doesn't block this creature, it can't be blocked.)

needs.what: A static effect that constrains how a creature may be blocked, evaluated when blocks are declared and again when they are validated as a set. Tromokratis needs the 'all creatures the defending player controls must be blocking this creature, or the block is illegal' variant, which is a whole-declaration legality check rather than a per-pair one; the same effect should cover the ordinary 'can't be blocked' and 'can't be blocked except by N or more creatures' cases.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only static effects available are buff, grant_keyword, set_pt, add_subtype and extra_land_drops -- none of them speaks about blocking at all. The nearest existing thing is the menace keyword, but it is a fixed hardcoded rule rather than a parameterised one: combat.blocks_valid is documented as 'Menace is the only one implemented' and hardcodes len(blockers) < 2, and combat.can_block only knows about tapped/controller/protection, so there is no seam where a card-supplied blocking restriction could be consulted. Granting menace instead would be an approximation (2 blockers, not all of them) and is refused.
